## Scientific integrity

- [ ] New visual effects are not presented as measurements.
- [ ] New datasets include source, resolution, coordinate convention, and coverage.
- [ ] Missing data remains explicit instead of being replaced with fabricated values.
- [ ] Operational or medical safety is not claimed.
